Launch CodingManageR on a Multi-User Server (MySQL/MariaDB Mode)

Source: R/app.R
run_app_server.Rd

Constructs and returns a shiny.appobj configured strictly for multi-user server deployments (such as Shiny Server Open Source) backed by a central MySQL or MariaDB database pool.

Usage

run_app_server(
  config = NULL,
  empty = TRUE,
  max_upload_size_gb = 3,
  options = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

config

Optional named list of MySQL/MariaDB connection parameters passed to get_db_pool() (host, port, user, password, dbname, minSize, maxSize, idleTimeout). When NULL (default, recommended for server deployments), credentials are read from .Renviron.

empty

Logical passed to seed_initial_data() when initializing a brand-new database. Defaults to TRUE. When omitted, the optional CODINGMANAGER_EMPTY environment variable is consulted before falling back to TRUE.

max_upload_size_gb

Positive numeric maximum file upload size in gigabytes applied via options(shiny.maxRequestSize = ...) while the app runs (restored cleanly on app shutdown). Defaults to 3 (3 GB). When omitted, the optional CODINGMANAGER_MAX_UPLOAD_GB environment variable is consulted before falling back to 3. Set to NULL to leave the existing shiny.maxRequestSize option unchanged.

options

Optional list of options forwarded to shiny::shinyApp().

...

Additional arguments forwarded to shiny::shinyApp().

Value

A shiny.appobj object suitable for returning from a Shiny Server app.R entrypoint.

Details

Unlike run_app_local() and run_app(), run_app_server() permanently disables the SQLite fallback (fallback_to_sqlite = FALSE). If MySQL/MariaDB credentials are missing or the database server cannot be reached, startup stops with an actionable error message rather than silently creating a local SQLite file on the server.

On Shiny Server, create your app.R entrypoint once with a zero-argument call to CodingManageR::run_app_server() (or copy the bundled file via system.file("shiny", "app.R", package = "CodingManageR")) and store all database and runtime settings in .Renviron:

  • Required database variables: MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_USER (plus MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_PASSWORD, and MYSQL_DBNAME).

  • Optional runtime variables: CODINGMANAGER_EMPTY (TRUE/FALSE, default TRUE) and CODINGMANAGER_MAX_UPLOAD_GB (positive number in GB or "null", default 3).

Because all configuration resides in .Renviron and all logic resides inside the package, future updates of CodingManageR require only updating the R package and restarting Shiny Server – no manual edits to app.R are needed.

See also

run_app_local(), run_app()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Minimal, set-once Shiny Server app.R (reads credentials from .Renviron)
CodingManageR::run_app_server()

# Explicit programmatic MySQL/MariaDB configuration
CodingManageR::run_app_server(
  config = list(
    host = "127.0.0.1",
    port = 3306L,
    user = "shiny_user",
    password = "secret",
    dbname = "kodierer_portal"
  )
)
} # }
